facts.statement: Oceanosuchus was a marine crocodylomorph belonging to the family Pholidosauridae.
facts.quote: Oceanosuchus is a genus of pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian, a type of marine crocodylomorph.

facts.statement: Oceanosuchus had a skull rostrum that was relatively short compared to other members of its family.
facts.quote: The rostrum of the skull was relatively short compared to other pholidosaurids.

facts.statement: Fossils of Oceanosuchus include a skull and partial skeleton discovered in early Cenomanian rocks in Normandy, France.
facts.quote: It is known from a skull and partial skeleton found in early Cenomanian-age rocks from Normandy, France.

facts.statement: The genus Oceanosuchus was formally described in 2007 by Hua and colleagues.
facts.quote: Oceanosuchus was described in 2007 by Hua and colleagues.

facts.statement: Oceanosuchus is classified within the family Pholidosauridae.
Oceanosuchus lived during the Cenomanian stage, approximately 100.5 to 93.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Cenomanian (100.5 to 93.9 million years ago)
